# cloudsmith_saml_auth (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug for SAML authentication
- `saml_auth_enabled` (Boolean) Enable SAML authentication for the organization
- `saml_auth_enforced` (Boolean) Enforce SAML authentication for the organization

### Optional

- `saml_metadata_inline` (String) Inline SAML metadata XML
- `saml_metadata_url` (String) URL to fetch SAML metadata

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
